decisions.decision: SSM secrets publish runs on the Ansible controller via delegate_to: localhost + become: false + ansible_python_interpreter=ansible_playbook_python
decisions.rationale: Packer amazon-ebs launches the build VM with no IAM instance profile; controller already holds operator creds (same ones Packer uses); also removes any boto3-on-AMI need

decisions.decision: Amazon DCV chosen over xrdp and gnome-remote-desktop
decisions.rationale: xrdp not packaged for AL2023 (no EPEL); DCV is AWS-supported on AL2023 ≥2023.7, free on EC2, browser client on :8443 (eventual noVNC replacement); gnome-remote-desktop (in AL2023 repos, RDP :3389) is the fallback if literal RDP ever required

decisions.decision: DCV coexists with VNC/noVNC; auth = PAM (authentication="system") reusing dev_user password the desktop role sets from desktop_vnc_password — no new secret, no new SSM parameter
decisions.rationale: Same PAM path TigerVNC SecurityTypes=Plain already uses; zero new secret surface

decisions.decision: DCV pinned to 2025.0 build 20103, sha256 pin deferred until first bake
decisions.rationale: REP posture; matches the Packer SSM :NN deferred-pin pattern in CLAUDE.md §9
